name: game-designer
description: Research-backed game design skills for every genre: fun curves and pacing diagnostics, 26 genre playbooks, progression/economy/gacha simulators, GDD and art-direction templates, design reviews with dark-pattern checks, and playable prototypes with self-tests. Answers in your language.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills that work like a senior game designer: design briefs (MDA, pillars, core loops), interest-curve plotting and pacing diagnostics, 26 genre playbooks, XP/economy/gacha simulators with exact pity math, cost-curve outlier detection, GDD and art/audio direction templates, accessibility checklists, design reviews with a dark-pattern ethics pass, and playable browser prototypes with self-tests and bots. Answers in the user's language with English terms in parentheses.
capabilities: Design briefs with pillars and core loops
